g.text: Screen: "Do you feel lonely? Who visits weekly?" → prescribe: worship + market-day routines +
grandchild time + elder groups + phone credit + radio + befrienders + day centres where apt.

svg.text: FAMILY MEETING (run it, don't dread it)

g.text: Invite (elder + key kin + decision-maker) → agenda (ONE page: facts → options → decision) →
elder speaks FIRST → facts plain → options honest (home vs admit vs palliative) → decide +
document + date review. Conflicts: private caucuses, "what would Mama want?", mediator if stuck.
SPOT IT
exhaustion, tears,
anger, illness,
"can't cope"
Zarit-4 if used
RELIEVE IT
respite (hours→
weeks), share rota,
day care, home help
rest = safety
EQUIP IT
train (lifts, meds,
dementia tips), aids,
emergency numbers
teach-back all
SUPPORT MAP (Ghana-real): family rota (share nights/bathing/market) + neighbours
+ worship groups + CHPS home visits + social welfare + NHIS + LEAP/disability where apt +
hired help vetted + private home-care vetted (PRO-II M6: licence check!). Write the map,
share numbers, review monthly — unsupported carers break, and broken carers harm.
COMMUNICATION: elder DIRECT first (consent, goals — PRO-I M2/M4), family WITH
consent; bad news SPIKES-style (setting, perception, invite, knowledge, emotion, plan);
dementia updates scheduled (not corridor ambushes); money talk early (who pays? NHIS?
exemptions? — PRO-II M5) to prevent discharge crises. Document meetings (who/decided/date).
GRIEF (before + after death): anticipatory grief normal — name it, normalise, support;
widowhood risks (depression, suicide, self-neglect — M03 screens) need follow-up visits,
not condolences alone. Rituals honoured (washing, prayers, funerals — Ghana's goodbyes
matter); complicated grief (stuck months, can't function) referred.
Exam line: \"loneliness screened, families met, carers treated as second patients.\"
